shapeVolume.note: Locked blocking intact; groove core removes blue slivers and dark wedges, cells now read as solid masses. Chips barely perceptible.

color.note: Peach-cream tops over a clearly deeper warm tan front that darkens toward the seabed; gentle per-slab variation; still clearly pale/warm vs bedrock and not more orange than target. Main goal met.

lightingHighlights.note: Grey rim gone; chamfer now warm. But the top-to-front break is smeared (see blocker 2).

materialDetail.note: Strata present and aligned across seams; pores and cracks exist but are too sparse/thin to register at use size.

artifactFreeReadability.note: Old blue slivers/diagonal lines fixed; new soft smudge band under top edges and blurred vertical streaks at slab front edges and around chips.

observations: Phone-size (360 px assembly) read moved from cream tiles to warm sandstone/limestone blocks; this is the biggest win and matches criterion 1.

Seam continuity: across the assembly and every seam-stress group (rows, columns, 3x3 mask-15 mixes, L joins, singles), top tone, front strata heights, chamfer and light do not jump at cell seams. Strata line up horizontally. No crack is cut by a cell edge. Passes.

Grooves: no seabed blue inside cells, no dark wedges; the groove core reads as a warm dark line on tops. On front faces between slabs it reads as a soft blurred darker V/streak rather than a thin line (part of blocker 2).

Cracks: thin dark hairlines on 0-2 slabs per pattern (pattern b has none). At 2x they are visible; at published 384 and at phone assembly size they nearly vanish, so the stone does not yet read as cracked/breakable. Target shows more and slightly bolder cracks with lighter edges.
Chipped corners: one or two tiny nicks visible only at native size; target's chipped top corners (within tolerance) are a stronger breakable cue.
Pores: sparse dots, correct density for 2x detail; invisible at use size as intended.

Native close-up (reef-15-c): directly under each top chamfer the front face has a wavy, blurred darker band, and vertical lighter smears run down slab front edges and around the chip on the top-left slab corner; the strata themselves look smudged rather than soft-but-clean. Reads like a texture/normal smoothing artifact at 2x; at phone size it softens the top/front edge.
Rubble: shares limestone palette, lit tops and tan sides; crisp, low. Alpha edges clean on near-black and grey, no halo.

Seam-stress sheet bottom-right L group: the upper piece's west face sits ~0.08 cell left of the lower piece's inset face. Consistent with the sheet pairing a W-solid mask above a W-open one (stress layout), not a piece defect; noted only.

blockers.location: all cell pieces, slab tops (cracks/chips); pattern b has zero cracked slabs
blockers.effect: Breakable cues disappear at the published 384x1024 and phone assembly size; the reef reads as warm stone bricks, not cracked breakable limestone (criterion 3).
blockers.desired: Cracks on roughly a third to half of slabs in every pattern (a, b and c), one or two each, with a slightly wider dark core plus a pale lip/edge so they survive the 2x downsample; a few small chipped top corners per cell (within 0.03 cell, top edges only) with a lit facet. Keep them seam-safe (within a slab or world-continuous) and calm, not noisy.

blockers.location: front faces just below every top chamfer; vertical front edges of slabs; around chips; front grooves between slabs
blockers.effect: Blurred wavy dark band under the top edge and vertical smears make the top/front break and strata look smudged at 2x and soften the block volume at phone size (criteria 4 and 5).
blockers.desired: A crisp chamfer-to-front transition: warm highlight on the chamfer, then clean front tan with soft but well-defined horizontal strata bands; no smear along slab edges or chips. Front grooves between slabs read as thin dark lines, not blurred V wedges. Likely check normal smoothing / shader bevel radius / texture coordinate stretching on the side faces.
